The player's sprite base is always at (0, 0) with their head at (0, 1 up) (but ignore the head, movement is relative to the base). Note that the player cannot move diagonally, so if a location is at say (1 right, 1 up), you would say '1 tile right and 1 tile up'. Only describe location when we are in the overworld, do not do so during dialogue, battles, or menus. Ledges are important to note as they can only be crossed in one direction. Tall grass is important to note as it can trigger wild Pokémon battles. Be aware of obstacles like trees and water.

When describing specific locations, mention the vertical direction before the horizontal direction.
When describing NPC locations, use the base of the NPC as the reference point and not their head.
